MARION HEIGHTS POLICE DEPARTMENT
INCIDENT REPORT (LATE FILING — 11 DAYS POST-INCIDENT)
Report No.: MHPD-2024-06-3318
Reporting Officer: R. Dowling, Badge #226
Date Report Filed: 06/18/2024 (Incident Date: 06/07/2024)
Reason for Late Filing: "Workload."

NARRATIVE:
On 06/07/2024 at approx 2114 hours, Officer Esquivel (#341) and I were on directed patrol in the 1800 block of Cedar Street following community complaints about "loitering and suspicious activity." We observed a female subject (later identified as ELLIS, Maya T., DOB 04/03/1995) walking a medium-sized dog. Subject was not in violation of any ordinance.

We made a consensual contact. Subject was cooperative initially. After approximately 4 minutes of conversation, subject "became argumentative" and questioned our authority to stop her. Officer Esquivel used "minimal force consistent with department training" to place subject in a seated position on the curb. No injuries observed at the scene.

Subject was released without charge after approximately 20 minutes.

No body-worn camera footage available — both officer cameras were "in charging cycle" per equipment status at start of shift.

/s/ R. Dowling, 06/18/2024
